release_read.basis: Revenue (~$201m, +13% y/y), $28m cash use and $134m cash were all pre-released on 15 Oct; the new lines are a reiterated Q4 2026 positive-EBITDAS target (the short thesis leaned on it having been dropped), the 15-16% FY growth guide held, Q4 cash use 'relatively flat' and gross margin about -3% (vs -68% a year ago). Mildly positive against a 21% short book, well inside the 12.4% implied move.
